input.command:
cd /Users/arijit/Coding/Python/DataQ; pkill -f "mkdocs serve"; git status --short; gh issue create --title "docs(site): looping clips never start on Safari/WebKit after instant navigation" --label bug,documentation --milestone "v1.2 Week 5 — native engines (DMF) + notification channels" --body "$(cat <<'EOF'
## What happens
Open the docs home page: the tour clip autoplays. Navigate to any other page and come back (sidebar link, logo, or browser Back): the clip is frozen on its poster, and since the `<video>` has no `controls` there is no way to start it. Same for the three clips on *Your first suite*.

## Root cause
`navigation.instant` swaps page content parsed from an inert `DOMParser` document. WebKit never runs media resource selection for a `<video autoplay>` adopted that way — reproduced with Playwright WebKit: after the swap `readyState === 0`, `networkState === 0` (NETWORK_EMPTY), no error. Chromium and Firefox start the same element fine, which is why the capture lane and the review pass missed it.

## Fix
`docs/site/assets/clips.js` subscribed to Material's `document$`: on every (instant) page load, `load()` any autoplay video still at `readyState 0`, call `play()`, and turn on `controls` if playback is refused, so there is always a manual fallback.

Verified in Chromium, WebKit and Firefox via Playwright: home → install → logo, and Back/Forward, all leave the clip playing; the three tutorial clips play after instant navigation in WebKit.
EOF
)"

Result:
Review of PR #1844 (`fix(docs): restart autoplay clips after instant navigation on WebKit`) — a 15-line `docs/site/assets/clips.js` plus its `extra_javascript` registration in `mkdocs.yml`. Given the diff size I ran all angles inline rather than fanning out agents.

Angles checked: line-by-line (guard condition, `play()` promise handling, detached-element rejections), removed behaviour (none — new file), cross-file (`document$` is exposed by Material's bundle, which the base template loads before `extra_javascript`; `assets/clips.js` resolves under `docs_dir` `docs/site`; the four `<video autoplay loop muted playsinline>` elements in `index.md` / `first-suite.md` are the only targets), reuse (no other docs JS exists), conventions (`Fixes #1843` present; one functionality; no CLAUDE.md rule broken). The `.catch` → `controls = true` path can fire spuriously on an element detached by a fast second navigation (pending play promises reject with `AbortError` on removal), but that only toggles an attribute on a node no longer in the document, so it is verified-benign.
